reference: Noam Elkies, Greg Kuperberg, Michael Larsen and James Propp, Journal of Algebraic Combinatorics 1, 111 and 219 (1992), counted the domino tilings of the Aztec diamond of order n (there are 2^{n(n+1)/2}) and gave the shuffling algorithm that samples one uniformly. William Jockusch, James Propp and Peter Shor, 'Random domino tilings and the arctic circle theorem' (1998), proved that a uniformly random tiling is frozen outside the inscribed circle and disordered inside it. James Propp, Theoretical Computer Science 303, 267 (2003), on generalized domino shuffling.
equation: order n → n+1: delete colliding pairs, slide N↑ S↓ W← E→, fill each empty 2×2 block with a random pair
limitations: The tab's own frozen share on the status line and its Frozen versus free coloring use a local test (every adjacent cell in the diamond carries the domino's type). Over independent seeds it tends to 0.2778 ± 0.0009 of the diamond, 67 standard errors above the arctic-circle area 1 - pi/4 = 0.2146, so it is not a measurement of the arctic region. This disagreement is why the status is partial; see validation/AZTEC.md.

Exact uniformity is established by exhaustive enumeration only at orders 1 to 5, run through the tab's build() and shuffle() below the UI range of 8 to 320; larger orders are tested only through the arctic boundary statistics.

The polar-region area and the axis radius agree with 1 - pi/4 and 1/sqrt(2) only after extrapolation in n with the stated form q_inf + A n^-2/3 + B n^-1 (0.3 and 0.7 sigma); a two-parameter n^-2/3 fit over orders 113 to 320 differs by 2.5 and 3.1 sigma, and at order 320 the polar area is still 0.030 above its limit.
Uniformity probabilities assume the seeded U.makeRng streams behave as independent uniform draws; fixed PRNG samples do not prove it.
Print evidence covers five recipes on one renderer (headless Chromium 141, SwiftShader, Linux). Grain is a raster finish that the vector print omits.
remaining: Replace or relabel the local frozen test and the printed frozen share (for example with the corner-connected polar regions in tools/lib/aztec-reference.js), rerun node tools/aztec-science.js --write, and review promotion.
Extend print evidence to other renderers and more recipes; extend exhaustive uniformity beyond order 5 only with a different method (the count is 2^{n(n+1)/2}).

numerical.scope: The tab's own build(), shuffle(), dominoes() and frozen test run unmodified in Node: exhaustive enumeration and sampled frequencies at orders 1 to 5; polar-region area, axis radius, fluctuation exponent and the tab's frozen share over 1,950 independent seeds at orders 40, 57, 80, 113, 160, 226 and 320; five complete rendered recipes (orders 8 to 180) with every SVG rectangle, every PNG byte and the shell vector RIP at 8 in and 300 ppi.
numerical.criteria: Tiling counts equal 2^{n(n+1)/2}; per order, Pearson chi-square p >= 0.001, no tiling undrawn, all tiling and domino-placement probabilities inside a simultaneous Hoeffding bound and a Bonferroni z bound at alpha 0.001; extrapolated polar area and axis radius within 3 sigma of 1 - pi/4 and 1/sqrt(2); four-fold symmetry within 3 sigma; tab frozen flags equal the stated definition on every plate; SVG coordinates <= 0.00501 px, PNG bytes <= 1, shell print equal to the rasterized reference SVG, state unchanged.
numerical.benchmark: Backtracking enumeration of every tiling (Elkies, Kuperberg, Larsen and Propp 1992 count), exact domino placement probabilities from that enumeration, and the Jockusch-Propp-Shor arctic circle for the corner-connected polar regions measured independently of the module, with Johansson's n^{1/3} fluctuation scale for the finite-size form; geometry rebuilt from the documented layout.
numerical.failureControl: A creation coin biased to 0.7 fails uniformity at orders 1 to 4 (chi-square up to 138,442 on 1,023) and moves the axis radii apart by 113 standard errors at order 160; removing the destruction step is rejected by the independent tiling check (26,830 of 40,960 draws at order 4); another seed's tiling fails the SVG check; a one-pixel shift fails the PNG check.
numerical.limitations: The tab's local frozen share tends to 0.278, not 1 - pi/4; exhaustive uniformity only at orders 1 to 5; the arctic comparison depends on the stated extrapolation; one renderer.

print.scope: Five recipes loaded through the recipe hash in a temporary copy of dist/studio.html (orders 8, 28, 60, 120 and 180; type, orientation and frozen coloring; inset 0 to 0.12; stroke on and off; circle on and off; grain 0), exported at 2,400 by 2,400 px by the module and by the shell's own Export.
print.criteria: Browser tiling equals the Node run byte for byte and survives one-shuffle chunking; every SVG rectangle within 0.00501 px of independently computed geometry with every fill, stroke and circle ink right; module PNG within one level of an independent painting everywhere; shell PNG identical to the rasterized reference SVG; shell SVG carries the same geometry and provenance; recipe and tiling unchanged after export.
print.benchmark: Backtracking enumeration of every tiling (Elkies, Kuperberg, Larsen and Propp 1992 count), exact domino placement probabilities from that enumeration, and the Jockusch-Propp-Shor arctic circle for the corner-connected polar regions measured independently of the module, with Johansson's n^{1/3} fluctuation scale for the finite-size form; geometry rebuilt from the documented layout.
print.failureControl: Another seed's tiling of the same order fails the SVG check; the reference painting shifted by one pixel differs in 99,001 to 1,923,963 channels.
print.limitations: Five recipes, one renderer; grain is not printed by the vector path.

domain.parameters: Orders 1 to 5 (exhaustive uniformity, below the UI range) and 40, 57, 80, 113, 160, 226, 320 (arctic statistics); the five print recipes in validation/results/aztec-science.json.
domain.conditions: Uniform domino shuffling from the order-1 tiling with seeded U.makeRng streams (recipe seeds aztec-uniform-n<n>-<i>, aztec-arctic-n<n>-<i>, aztec-print-<k>); no grain in the print fixtures; exports must preserve recipe and tiling.
domain.resolution: Exact integer tilings; sampling errors as stated (standard errors over 100 to 400 independent seeds per order, 1,000-replicate seed bootstrap for extrapolations); prints at 2,400 by 2,400 px (8 in, 300 ppi).
domain.precision: Integer tilings and Binary64 statistics; SVG coordinates rounded to 0.01 px; RGBA8 raster; Node 22 and headless Chromium 141 with SwiftShader recorded in the results.
